verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents a package system of Providers, Functions, and portable Configurations (docs-10, docs-11, docs-26). Its official CLI supports building, installing, updating and pushing packages (docs-9), and the vendor promotes a library of reusable components to assemble platforms (docs-27). Package signature verification is also documented (docs-39), so both consuming and publishing reusable modules are covered. Missing for 10: an explicitly named public registry or marketplace in the evidence, documentation of discovery and search in that registry, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the publish/consume workflow.
